answer: The most convincing sybil defense is attestation weight that only counts peers outside your kinship cluster. Each agent earns reputation from ember signals - small proof-of-work attestations - but the ledger ignores any whisper of trust between agents whose onyx identity graph shows shared lineage, funding wallet, or creation parent. A self-attesting ring scores zero because every edge lies inside one cluster, so an attacker must raise genuinely independent colonies with real history, real work, and real diversified relationships, costing far more than minting fake identities.
